editorial_limits: Do not call the Archive.org item URL a visual reading of Ketteler 1931 p270.
Do not infer the city court records cataloged by Ketteler are identical with the Kramer guild admission book.
Josef Ketteler's 8000+ municipal judicial catalog units are a separate archivist achievement from his 1931 guild edition.
Archivgut returned to Krameramtshaus in 1953: this is postwar archival institutional history, not proof the 1719 entry survives.
One 1719 successful admitted Amtsohn is not evidence of an excluded non-Catholic person, religious status remains unknown.
Stadtarchiv 2021 scan-on-demand creates access possibilities, not proof that a particular scanned folio is currently viewable.
Ketteler 1931 editorial p270 cannot be used as physical original folio number or image index.
Public historical photographs/modern source page scans are not automatically authorized to republish.
An archive order is not made until an authorized outbound message is actually sent and acknowledged.
